compute_vote_loss: compute the vote loss by matching predicted votes to ground truth votes for seed points
compute_objectness_loss: compute the objectness loss for proposals by comparing aggregated vote centers to ground truth object centers
compute_box_and_sem_cls_loss: compute 3D bounding box center, heading, size losses and semantic classification loss for object proposals
get_loss: compute the total combined loss including vote, objectness, box, and semantic classification losses across all branches
review_loss_helper_constants: review the FAR_THRESHOLD, NEAR_THRESHOLD, GT_VOTE_FACTOR, and OBJECTNESS_CLS_WEIGHTS constants used in loss computation
